title: Print the ML Types
description: Write a Python script that displays the three main types of machine learning.
problemStatement:
# Objective
Create a Python script that prints the three fundamental types of machine learning, each on its own line.

## Expected Output
```
1. Supervised Learning
2. Unsupervised Learning
3. Reinforcement Learning
```

Make sure your output matches exactly (including the numbering). Use the `print()` function.
hints: Use three separate print statements or a multi‑line string.
Remember, in Python you can print with `print("1. Supervised Learning")` etc.
expectedOutput:
1. Supervised Learning
2. Unsupervised Learning
3. Reinforcement Learning
solutionCode:
# Solution: Print the three ML types
print("1. Supervised Learning")
print("2. Unsupervised Learning")
print("3. Reinforcement Learning")
